Groundswell Event Management · THE REGFIRE SUITE

The people and planning behind the experience.

Bring the whole event together.

Groundswell Event Management focuses on bringing the whole event together, from early planning through onsite execution. For organizers balancing schedules, people and operational details, the approach connects responsibilities with a clear plan. The result is fewer loose ends and a coordinated team that understands what needs to happen next.

Conversational guidance Conversational event management helps you explain the outcome you want and refine the plan with practical guidance. Groundswell brings that guidance together with the judgment and service of the people delivering the event.
